Welcome.eyebrow: Welcome to Be Real Humanitarian Works
Welcome.title: People. Purpose. A Kinder World.
Welcome.body: At Be Real Humanitarian Works Inc., we believe compassion becomes meaningful when it becomes action. We exist to meet practical needs, restore dignity, encourage hope, and help vulnerable people move forward. Our work is inspired by Christian faith and expressed through service to people in need.
Welcome.imageAlt: A mother embracing her child, part of the community Be Real Humanitarian Works serves
Welcome.quote: A world in which vulnerable people are seen, supported, treated with dignity, and given meaningful opportunities to experience hope, stability, and a better future.

Programs.title: What We Do
Programs.intro: We focus on practical, people-centered programs that address urgent needs and create opportunities for brighter futures.

health-and-hope.purpose: Humanitarian and health-related support for vulnerable, sick, disabled, elderly, and distressed people.
health-and-hope.alt: A Be Real Humanitarian Works team member listening to a family during a community visit

care.purpose: Practical relief and compassionate assistance for individuals and families facing hardship, including essential needs and community support.
care.alt: Be Real Humanitarian Works staff with schoolchildren at a community water point

empowerment.purpose: Programs and opportunities designed to strengthen individuals and communities through education, skills, resources, and pathways toward greater stability.
empowerment.alt: Students studying together with a mentor as part of an education and skills program

faith-and-community-outreach.purpose: Voluntary prayer, spiritual encouragement, missions, Christian humanitarian outreach, and community service. Essential humanitarian assistance is not conditioned on religious participation.
faith-and-community-outreach.alt: A community gathered together in prayer at sunset

Impact.title: Real Change Happens Together
Impact.body: Behind every need is a person with dignity, potential, and a story. Our goal is not simply to provide temporary relief, but to stand with people through compassionate service and practical support.

world.title: A More Compassionate World
world.description: Together, we can make a lasting difference.

GetInvolved.title: Be Part of Something Real
GetInvolved.body: You can help turn compassion into action. Give. Volunteer. Partner. Pray. Serve.

Footer.political: Be Real Humanitarian Works Inc. does not participate or intervene in political campaigns for or against candidates for public office.

AssistancePage.title: Ask for help
AssistancePage.lead: If you or someone you know is experiencing hardship, you may submit a request for consideration. Submitting a request does not guarantee assistance. Requests are reviewed based on charitable need, program criteria, available resources, and the organization's capacity.
AssistancePage.heroAlt: A Be Real Humanitarian Works team member listening to a family during a community visit

s1.body: Tell us about your situation using the form below — only the information we need, nothing sensitive.

s2.title: We review it
s2.body: Requests are reviewed based on charitable need, program criteria, available resources, and the organization's capacity.

s3.title: We contact you
s3.body: We reach out using the contact method you prefer. Submitting a request does not guarantee assistance.

About.title: Who We Are
About.lead: Be Real Humanitarian Works Inc. is a Texas nonprofit corporation recognized by the Internal Revenue Service as a tax-exempt organization under Section 501(c)(3). We are committed to humanitarian relief and community assistance for people experiencing poverty, sickness, disability, vulnerability, distress, and other significant needs.
About.heroImageAlt: Be Real Humanitarian Works volunteers and children in front of a community school

mission.title: Demonstrating God's love through practical service
mission.body: To demonstrate God's love through humanitarian relief, compassionate assistance, health-related support, poverty and hunger relief, empowerment, and community development for poor, sick, disabled, elderly, vulnerable, and distressed people.

vision.title: A world where vulnerable people are seen
vision.body: A world in which vulnerable people are seen, supported, treated with dignity, and given meaningful opportunities to experience hope, stability, and a better future.

compassion.title: Compassion
compassion.body: Respond to human need with dignity and care.

faith.title: Faith
faith.body: Serve from Christian principles while respecting every person.

dignity.title: Dignity
dignity.body: See people as people, not as projects.

empowerment.title: Empowerment
empowerment.body: Help people move toward stability and opportunity.

faith.title: Inspired by faith, open to all
faith.body: Our work is inspired by Christian principles of love, compassion, generosity, and service. We may offer voluntary prayer, spiritual encouragement, missions, and Christian outreach; however, essential humanitarian assistance is not conditioned on conversion, church membership, financial contribution, or participation in religious activities.
faith.imageAlt: A community gathered together in prayer at sunset

leadership.title: Board-governed, people-centered
leadership.intro: Be Real Humanitarian Works Inc. is governed by its board of directors.

facts.statusValue: Be Real Humanitarian Works Inc. is recognized by the IRS as a tax-exempt organization under Section 501(c)(3). Contributions are tax-deductible to the extent permitted by law.
